verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk export of all account data, no open export formats, and no offboarding or exit path. Warehouse Sync is documented as ingesting data from your warehouse into mParticle, the opposite direction. The forwarding and integration headlines describe routing live data to downstream vendors, an adjacent activation feature rather than a full data export for leaving the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
